content: CF official chat pattern: Worker stateless router calls env.NS.idFromName(roomName) (name<=32 chars) or idFromString(64-hex), then NS.get(id).fetch(url, request) to forward to DO. DO accepts WS via WebSocketPair + state.acceptWebSocket(ws, tags); handlers webSocketMessage/webSocketClose/webSocketError fire on wake; ws.serializeAttachment/getAttachment persist per-connection metadata across hibernation. Hibernation limits: 1MiB message, 32768 connections per DO. Hibernation only when DO is server side.
